name: intake
description: Intake: the owner's request kept word for word with sentence ids, and the pathway, stack and lane it proposes from bands (docs/design/intake.md).

CLAIM-SOURCE.fix: name the requests the intent comes from (request: [Q-<n>]) and give each goal line, story and requirement statement a source in brackets: a request sentence [Q-<n>.<k>], an answered question [Q<k>], an assumption [A<k>] listed under # Assumptions, or a fact [F-<n>] (docs: Intake)

ELAB-CORNER.fix: settle each surface of the corner checklist (aidlc persona product-analyst) on its own line under # Corners: - <Surface>: a requirement or bolt id, a source such as [A<k>], or n/a: and why (docs: Elaboration checks)

ELAB-PERSONA.fix: list each kind of user the request names under # Personas, as - **<Name>**: <who they are and what they want> [source], or set onePersona: "<why one kind of user>" (docs: Elaboration checks)

ELAB-STORY.fix: give each persona a story under # Stories: - As a <persona>, I want <capability>, so that <benefit>. R-<n> [source], citing a requirement the intent cites (docs: Elaboration checks)

UNIT-WORK.fix: list the intent's units of work under # Units, each a ## <name> with Kind, Modules, Responsibilities, Stories, Requirements, Risks, Measures and Depends on lines; give each story an id US<g>.<s> and each success measure an id M<k> (docs: Units of work)

REQUEST-COVERAGE.fix: cite each sentence of the request where the intent or a requirement answers it, or under # Out of scope with the reason (docs: Intake)

commands.name: intake
commands.does: keep the owner's request word for word as requests/Q-<n>, and propose its pathway, stack and lane

messages.intakeUsage: usage: aidlc intake "<the owner's words>" or --file <path>; then aidlc intake Q-<n> --ambiguity|--risk|--assumptions <band>:<sentence ids>
messages.intakeEmpty: the request holds no sentence: pass the owner's words as they wrote them
messages.intakeBand: {{factor}} {{value}}: write <band>:<ids>, a band of {{bands}} and the request's sentence ids
messages.intakeNoIds: {{factor}} {{band}} cites no sentence: a medium or high band names the sentences it rests on
messages.intakeRiskFloor: risk {{band}} is below what the request's words show ({{floor}}): risk is raised, never lowered
messages.intakeModels: models that fit: {{models}}; once the owner picks one: aidlc models apply <name>
messages.intakeTell: tell the owner in two or three plain sentences what kind of change this is and how much process it needs, then this proposal; they confirm or change it, and the intent records request: {{id}}, pathway and lane
messages.intakeVerification: a test level that runs: {{tests}}; CI: {{ci}}
messages.claimNoRequest: {{unit}} names no request: keep the owner's words with aidlc intake and record request: [Q-<n>]
messages.claimNoSuchRequest: {{unit}} names {{ref}}, which is no request in {{dir}}
messages.claimSentence: {{unit}} cites {{ref}}, which is no sentence of its requests ({{requests}})
messages.claimQuestion: {{unit}} cites {{ref}}, which is no answered question of {{intent}}
messages.claimAssumption: {{unit}} cites {{ref}}, which {{intent}} does not list under # Assumptions
messages.claimFact: {{unit}} cites {{ref}}, which is no platform fact
messages.cornerUnsettled: {{unit}} leaves the {{surface}} corner unsettled: name a requirement or bolt, a source, or n/a: and why
messages.readBackMissing: {{unit}} ends with no read-back: ask a last question, Q<k> Read-back: <the summary>, with a) looks correct and b) request changes
messages.storyForm: {{unit}} story does not read As a <persona>, I want <capability>, so that <benefit>: {{text}}
messages.storyPersona: {{unit}} story is for {{persona}}, who is not under # Personas ({{personas}})
messages.storyNoRequirement: {{unit}} story for {{persona}} cites none of the intent's requirements ({{reqs}})
messages.unitsNone: {{unit}} lists no unit of work under # Units
messages.unitName: {{unit}} unit of work {{name}} is not a lower-case path segment
messages.unitTwice: {{unit}} names the unit of work {{name}} twice
messages.unitPart: {{unit}} unit of work {{name}} has no {{part}} line
messages.unitKind: {{unit}} unit of work {{name}} has kind {{kind}}, not one of {{kinds}}
messages.unitModule: {{unit}} unit of work {{name}} changes {{module}}, which is no module of the profile
messages.unitRequirement: {{unit}} unit of work {{name}} cites {{req}}, which the intent does not cite
messages.unitMeasure: {{unit}} unit of work {{name}} measure cites no success measure of the intent: {{text}}
messages.unitStory: {{unit}} unit of work {{name}} lists {{story}}, which is no story of the intent
messages.unitNoStory: {{unit}} unit of work {{name}} lists no story
messages.storyNoUnit: {{unit}} story {{story}} is in no unit of work
messages.unitDepends: {{unit}} unit of work {{name}} depends on {{other}}, which the intent does not list
messages.unitCycle: {{unit}} units of work depend on each other in a circle: {{cycle}}
messages.boltNoUnit: {{unit}} bolt {{bolt}} changes {{modules}}, which no unit of work lists
messages.readBackChanges: {{unit}} {{q}}: the owner asked for changes to the read-back; revise, then read back again

corners.asks: empty, too long, wrong type or format, duplicates, characters from other languages, files too large.
who may do it, who may not, a session that expired, acting on behalf of someone else.
what is kept, for how long, who may read it, personal data, deletion on request, the same record changed twice at once.
what the user sees, what is logged, what is retried, what happens halfway through.
how many users, how much data, the busiest hour, what slows down first.
time zones, dates at month and year ends, deadlines, things that expire.
currency, rounding, refunds, a payment that fails or arrives twice.
one is slow, down, or answers something unexpected.
how it is deployed, how a bad release is rolled back, how the owner knows it works.
existing users and data when this ships, an older client still in use.
